notes.title: Isles of Isvenness Demo Phase 3
notes.notes:
We've launched a new demo build with the latest updates and features in preparation for Steam Next Fest.  Join in on the fun and collect up to 12 Aethlings and 5 rare variants in the latest version!

Wishlist the game, play the demo, and support the on-going developments!  Release date to be announced after Next Fest.  Stay tuned!

notes.title: Isles of Isvenness Demo Phase 2
notes.notes:
Thank you so much for all your support!  After receiving helpful initial feedback since the demo launch, I've been working towards building a system for the Aethlings to be used as a team.

I'm excited to release and include the new missions system into the latest Demo version!  Let me know what you think!  Feedback is always welcome and appreciated! :)

notes.title: Isles of Isvenness Demo Released!
notes.notes: The Isles of Isvenness Demo launches today!  Join Kazu on the Isles of Isvenness in summoning and collecting Aethlings.  Cozily nest the islands around your screen while you progress at your own pace.

notes.title: Steam page launch -- wishlist today!
notes.notes:
I'm excited to launch the Steam page of Isles of Isvenness -- a creature collecting and resource gathering game uniquely featuring movable island overlay game components.  I've been working on this project with my partner for the last several months and it is great finally seeing all our efforts come together.

We are planning to release a public demo soon -- stay tuned!
